text.tspan: An early payout bet usually wins if your chosen
team leads by at least two goals. However, for
the UEFA Champions League, we have added a
1:0 early payout, which triggers even when
your team is ahead by just a single goal during
Go to the "Sports" section, place pre-match
early payout bets on upcoming UEFA
Champions League matches, and win as soon
as your team takes the lead!
